examples.en: Many families dwell in small apartments near the harbor.
examples.zh: 許多家庭住在港口附近的小公寓裡。

examples.en: Some old people still dwell in the village where they were born.
examples.zh: 有些老人仍然住在他們出生的村子裡。

examples.en: Try not to dwell on your mistakes after the exam.
examples.zh: 考試結束後，別老是想著自己的錯誤。

examples.en: The family moved into a new dwelling by the river.
examples.zh: 這家人搬進了河邊的新住所。

examples.en: Each dwelling in the village has a small garden.
examples.zh: 村裡的每間住宅都有一座小花園。

examples.en: The old dwelling was repaired before the winter began.
examples.zh: 那棟舊住宅在冬天開始前就修繕好了。

examples.en: Our eccentric neighbor wears a hat even indoors.
examples.zh: 我們那位古怪的鄰居連在室內也戴著帽子。

examples.en: The artist is known for his eccentric habits.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家以其怪異的習慣聞名。

examples.en: My uncle has an eccentric way of explaining math.
examples.zh: 我叔叔講解數學的方式與眾不同。

examples.en: Students watched the solar eclipse through special glasses.
examples.zh: 學生們透過特製眼鏡觀看日蝕。

examples.en: The lunar eclipse will begin around ten o'clock tonight.
examples.zh: 月蝕將在今晚十點左右開始。

examples.en: People gathered on the roof to see the eclipse.
examples.zh: 人們聚集在屋頂上觀看這場日蝕。

examples.en: Her talent began to eclipse that of the other players.
examples.zh: 她的才華開始讓其他選手黯然失色。

examples.en: The new mall may eclipse the old shopping street.
examples.zh: 這間新的購物中心可能會使老商店街相形失色。

examples.en: His success eclipsed all of his brother's achievements.
examples.zh: 他的成功使他哥哥的所有成就都黯然失色。

examples.en: Regular exercise can elevate your mood during exams.
examples.zh: 考試期間，規律運動能讓你的心情變好。

examples.en: The company plans to elevate her to department manager.
examples.zh: 公司打算把她升為部門經理。

examples.en: Please elevate your leg to reduce the swelling.
examples.zh: 請把腿抬高，以減輕腫脹。

examples.en: Many emigrants send money back to their families every month.
examples.zh: 許多移民每個月都會寄錢回家給家人。

examples.en: The emigrant missed the food from his hometown.
examples.zh: 那位移民很想念家鄉的食物。

examples.en: My grandfather was an emigrant who left Italy at twenty.
examples.zh: 我祖父是個二十歲就離開義大利的移民。

examples.en: Her parents decided to emigrate to Canada last year.
examples.zh: 她的父母去年決定移民加拿大。

examples.en: Many young workers emigrate in search of better jobs.
examples.zh: 許多年輕的工作者為了尋找更好的工作而移居國外。

examples.en: He plans to emigrate once he finishes his studies.
examples.zh: 他打算一完成學業就移居國外。

examples.en: Emigration from the small island has increased in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來，從這座小島移居國外的人數增加了。

examples.en: The government wants to slow down the emigration of doctors.
examples.zh: 政府想減緩醫師外移的情形。

examples.en: Her essay is about emigration and family life.
examples.zh: 她的文章談的是移居國外與家庭生活。

examples.en: I looked up the word in an encyclopedia at the library.
examples.zh: 我在圖書館的百科全書裡查了這個字。

examples.en: This online encyclopedia is free for everyone to use.
examples.zh: 這個線上百科全書任何人都能免費使用。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to read the encyclopedia entry on volcanoes.
examples.zh: 老師要我們閱讀百科全書中關於火山的條目。

examples.en: Learning a new language is a difficult endeavor.
examples.zh: 學習一種新語言是一件困難的事。

examples.en: The team made every endeavor to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 團隊盡了一切努力，要準時完成這項專案。

examples.en: Her endeavor to raise money for the school was a success.
examples.zh: 她為學校募款的努力成功了。

examples.en: We endeavor to answer every email within one day.
examples.zh: 我們盡力在一天內回覆每一封電子郵件。

examples.en: The teacher endeavored to make the lesson fun.
examples.zh: 老師努力讓這堂課變得有趣。

examples.en: Students should endeavor to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 學生應該盡力準時抵達。

examples.en: The university received a large endowment from a former student.
examples.zh: 這所大學收到一位校友捐贈的大筆基金。

examples.en: The endowment pays for scholarships every year.
examples.zh: 這筆基金每年用來支付獎學金。

examples.en: She has a natural endowment for music.
examples.zh: 她對音樂有與生俱來的天賦。

examples.en: The documentary helped enlighten viewers about climate change.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片幫助觀眾了解氣候變遷。

examples.en: Could you enlighten me on how this machine works?
examples.zh: 你能告訴我這台機器是怎麼運作的嗎？

examples.en: Good teachers enlighten their students and inspire them to learn.
examples.zh: 好老師會啟發學生，並激勵他們學習。

examples.en: Traveling abroad can enrich your understanding of other cultures.
examples.zh: 出國旅行能豐富你對其他文化的認識。

examples.en: Farmers use compost to enrich the soil.
examples.zh: 農夫用堆肥讓土壤更肥沃。

examples.en: Reading every night helped enrich her vocabulary.
examples.zh: 每晚閱讀幫助她充實了字彙量。

examples.en: Some people equate money with happiness when choosing their future careers.
examples.zh: 有些人在選擇未來職業時，會把金錢等同於快樂。

examples.en: You should not equate a high price with good quality.
examples.zh: 你不該把高價等同於高品質。

examples.en: It is wrong to equate silence with agreement.
examples.zh: 把沉默視為同意是不對的。

examples.en: A guard will escort you to the meeting room.
examples.zh: 警衛會陪你到會議室。

examples.en: Two officers escorted the visitors through the crowd.
examples.zh: 兩名警員護送訪客穿過人群。

examples.en: He offered to escort her home after the concert.
examples.zh: 他提議在音樂會後陪她回家。

examples.en: The president arrived with a police escort.
examples.zh: 總統在警察護衛下抵達。

examples.en: The bus had an escort of two motorcycles.
examples.zh: 那輛公車有兩輛機車護送。

examples.en: She asked her brother to be her escort at the dance.
examples.zh: 她請哥哥在舞會上當她的陪伴者。

examples.en: The students hold their principal in high esteem.
examples.zh: 學生們非常敬重他們的校長。

examples.en: Her honesty won her the esteem of her classmates.
examples.zh: 她的誠實贏得了同學的敬重。

examples.en: He earned the esteem of his coworkers through hard work.
examples.zh: 他靠著努力工作贏得了同事的敬重。

examples.en: Everyone in town esteems the old doctor.
examples.zh: 鎮上每個人都敬重那位老醫師。

examples.en: She is highly esteemed by her teammates.
examples.zh: 她深受隊友敬重。

examples.en: We esteem honesty above all other qualities.
examples.zh: 我們把誠實看得比其他品格都重要。

examples.en: The poem is about love that lasts for eternity.
examples.zh: 這首詩寫的是永恆的愛。

examples.en: The wait at the bus stop felt like an eternity.
examples.zh: 在公車站牌前等車感覺像是等了一輩子。

examples.en: Many religions teach that the soul lives for eternity.
examples.zh: 許多宗教教導人的靈魂會永遠存在。

examples.en: Teachers asked everyone to evacuate the building during the fire drill.
examples.zh: 在消防演習時，老師請大家撤離這棟大樓。

examples.en: Residents were told to evacuate before the typhoon arrived.
examples.zh: 居民被告知要在颱風來臨前撤離。

examples.en: The hotel had to evacuate all of its guests.
examples.zh: 旅館必須疏散所有的房客。

examples.en: Pine trees are evergreen, so they stay green all winter.
examples.zh: 松樹是常綠的，所以整個冬天都保持綠色。

examples.en: This evergreen plant needs very little water.
examples.zh: 這種常綠植物只需要很少的水。

examples.en: The singer's evergreen songs are still loved by many fans.
examples.zh: 那位歌手的長青歌曲仍深受許多歌迷喜愛。

examples.en: We decorated an evergreen for the holiday party.
examples.zh: 我們為節慶派對裝飾了一棵常綠樹。

examples.en: An evergreen can survive in very cold weather.
examples.zh: 常綠樹能在非常寒冷的天氣中存活。

examples.en: The garden has several tall evergreens along the fence.
examples.zh: 花園裡沿著圍籬種了幾棵高大的常綠樹。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread can evoke happy childhood memories.
examples.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味能喚起快樂的童年回憶。

examples.en: The old photo evoked strong feelings in my grandmother.
examples.zh: 那張舊照片在我祖母心中引起強烈的情感。

examples.en: The film's music helps evoke a sense of mystery.
examples.zh: 這部電影的音樂有助於營造神祕感。

examples.en: Each examinee must show an ID card at the door.
examples.zh: 每位考生都必須在門口出示身分證件。

examples.en: The examinee finished the test ten minutes early.
examples.zh: 那位考生提早十分鐘寫完了考卷。

examples.en: Examinees are not allowed to use their phones in the room.
examples.zh: 考生不可以在考場內使用手機。

examples.en: She excels at math and science and often helps her classmates.
examples.zh: 她的數學和科學表現突出，也常幫助同學。

examples.en: Our team hopes to excel in the national contest.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍希望在全國比賽中表現出色。

examples.en: He excelled in every subject during his first year.
examples.zh: 他第一年每一科都表現得很出色。

examples.en: The teacher read an excerpt from the novel to the class.
examples.zh: 老師對全班朗讀了這本小說的節錄。

examples.en: You can read a short excerpt on the publisher's website.
examples.zh: 你可以在出版社的網站上讀到一小段節錄。

examples.en: This excerpt comes from a speech given in 1963.
examples.zh: 這段節錄出自一九六三年的一場演說。

examples.en: An excess of sugar can harm your health.
examples.zh: 攝取過量的糖會損害健康。

examples.en: The airline charged us for the excess over the baggage allowance.
examples.zh: 航空公司向我們收取行李超出限額部分的費用。

examples.en: After filling the orders, the shop sold the excess at half price.
examples.zh: 完成訂單後，商店以半價出售剩餘商品。

examples.en: Pour the excess water out of the bowl.
examples.zh: 把碗裡多餘的水倒掉。

examples.en: You will be charged for excess baggage at the airport.
examples.zh: 在機場，超重的行李要另外收費。

examples.en: The cook cut off the excess fat from the meat.
examples.zh: 廚師把肉上多餘的肥肉切掉。

examples.en: The exclusion of children from the event upset many parents.
examples.zh: 小孩被排除在活動之外，讓許多家長感到不滿。

examples.en: Experiencing exclusion at school can hurt a student's confidence.
examples.zh: 在學校遭到排擠，可能會傷害學生的自信。

examples.en: The policy covers most repairs, with a few exclusions.
examples.zh: 這項保單涵蓋大多數的維修，只有少數除外情形。

examples.en: Students with a doctor's note are exempt from gym class.
examples.zh: 有醫師證明的學生可免上體育課。

examples.en: Books for children are exempt from the tax.
examples.zh: 兒童書籍可以免稅。

examples.en: Senior citizens are exempt from paying the entry fee.
examples.zh: 年長者免付入場費。

examples.en: The school will exempt her from the final exam.
examples.zh: 學校會讓她不必參加期末考。

examples.en: The new law exempts small shops from the fee.
examples.zh: 新法律讓小商店免繳這項費用。

examples.en: A bad knee exempted him from the long run.
examples.zh: 膝蓋不好讓他不必參加長跑。

examples.en: You must exert more effort if you want to pass the test.
examples.zh: 如果你想通過考試，就必須更加努力。

examples.en: Parents can exert a strong influence on their children.
examples.zh: 父母能對孩子施加很大的影響。

examples.en: He exerted all his strength to push open the heavy door.
examples.zh: 他使出全力，試圖推開那扇沉重的門。

examples.en: The family keeps a record of its monthly expenditure.
examples.zh: 這個家庭記錄每個月的支出。

examples.en: The city plans to cut its expenditure on road repairs.
examples.zh: 市政府打算削減道路維修的經費。

examples.en: Food is the largest expenditure for most students living abroad.
examples.zh: 對大多數在國外生活的學生來說，餐費是最大的開銷。

examples.en: Please check the expiration date on the milk.
examples.zh: 請檢查牛奶上的到期日。

examples.en: The expiration of the contract is next month.
examples.zh: 合約下個月就到期了。

examples.en: My passport is close to expiration, so I need a new one.
examples.zh: 我的護照快到期了，所以需要辦新的。

examples.en: My library card will expire at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 我的借書證將在月底到期。

examples.en: This coupon expires on Friday, so use it soon.
examples.zh: 這張優惠券週五到期，請儘快使用。

examples.en: Your visa will expire before the trip ends.
examples.zh: 你的簽證會在旅程結束前到期。

examples.en: The dentist had to extract a bad tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫必須拔掉一顆壞牙。

examples.en: This machine can extract juice from oranges very quickly.
examples.zh: 這台機器能很快地從柳橙中榨出果汁。

examples.en: Students were asked to extract the main ideas from the article.
examples.zh: 學生被要求從文章中摘出主要觀點。

examples.en: This cake is flavored with vanilla extract.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕是用香草精調味的。

examples.en: The soap contains an extract from green tea.
examples.zh: 這款肥皂含有綠茶萃取物。

examples.en: She read an extract from the story to the class.
examples.zh: 她對全班朗讀了這篇故事的節錄。

examples.en: Many students join extracurricular activities after school.
examples.zh: 許多學生放學後會參加課外活動。

examples.en: Chess club is her favorite extracurricular activity.
examples.zh: 西洋棋社是她最喜歡的課外活動。

examples.en: Too many extracurricular classes can leave children tired.
examples.zh: 太多課外課程可能會讓孩子很疲累。

examples.en: A tiny eyelash fell onto her cheek.
examples.zh: 一根小小的睫毛掉到她的臉頰上。

examples.en: The baby has long, dark eyelashes that curl at the tips.
examples.zh: 這個嬰兒有又長又黑、末端捲翹的睫毛。

examples.en: Be careful not to get the soap on your eyelashes.
examples.zh: 小心別讓肥皂沾到你的睫毛。

examples.en: The baby's eyelids closed as she fell asleep.
examples.zh: 寶寶睡著時，眼皮闔上了。

examples.en: He has a small bump on his left eyelid.
examples.zh: 他的左眼皮上有一個小腫塊。

examples.en: Cold tea bags can help reduce swelling in the eyelid.
examples.zh: 冷茶包有助於減輕眼瞼腫脹。

examples.en: The club split into two factions over the new rules.
examples.zh: 社團因為新規定而分裂成兩個派系。

examples.en: One faction of the committee wanted to build a library.
examples.zh: 委員會中有一派想蓋一座圖書館。

examples.en: Leaders tried to bring the rival factions together.
examples.zh: 領導者試圖讓相互對立的派系團結起來。

examples.en: Fahrenheit is used for many weather forecasts in the United States.
examples.zh: 美國許多天氣預報都使用華氏溫標。

examples.en: The thermometer can display temperatures in Fahrenheit or Celsius.
examples.zh: 這支溫度計能以華氏或攝氏顯示溫度。

examples.en: Many American recipes use Fahrenheit instead of Celsius.
examples.zh: 許多美國食譜使用華氏而不是攝氏。

examples.en: Her voice began to falter as she spoke on stage.
examples.zh: 她在台上說話時，聲音開始顫抖。

examples.en: The runner faltered near the finish line.
examples.zh: 那位跑者在接近終點線時腳步踉蹌。

examples.en: Sales faltered during the summer months as fewer tourists visited the town.
examples.zh: 夏季那幾個月，因為造訪小鎮的遊客減少，銷售表現轉弱了。

examples.en: His familiarity with the city helped us find the hotel.
examples.zh: 他對這座城市很熟悉，幫助我們找到了旅館。

examples.en: Familiarity with basic computer skills is required for this job.
examples.zh: 這份工作要求熟悉基本的電腦技能。

examples.en: There was a warm familiarity between the two old friends.
examples.zh: 這兩位老朋友之間有種溫暖的親切感。

examples.en: Children watched the magic show with fascination.
examples.zh: 孩子們著迷地看著魔術表演。

examples.en: She has a deep fascination with ancient history.
examples.zh: 她對古代歷史非常著迷。

examples.en: The museum holds a special fascination for young visitors.
examples.zh: 這座博物館對年輕的參觀者有特別的吸引力。

examples.en: Is it feasible to finish the project by Friday?
examples.zh: 要在週五前完成這項專案可行嗎？

examples.en: The engineer found a feasible way to cut costs.
examples.zh: 工程師找到了一個可行的方法來降低成本。

examples.en: Working from home is not feasible for every job.
examples.zh: 在家工作並非對每種工作都行得通。

examples.en: The old dog was too feeble to climb the stairs.
examples.zh: 那隻老狗太虛弱了，爬不了樓梯。

examples.en: She gave a feeble excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 她為遲到編了一個站不住腳的藉口。

examples.en: A feeble light came from the window.
examples.zh: 窗戶透出微弱的光。

examples.en: She chose a soft, feminine style for her room.
examples.zh: 她為房間選了柔和的女性風格。

examples.en: The shop sells feminine clothing for all ages.
examples.zh: 這家店販售適合各年齡層、具有女性風格的服飾。

examples.en: In French, the word for table is feminine.
examples.zh: 在法文裡，「桌子」這個字是陰性的。

examples.en: The river brings fertility to the farmland around it.
examples.zh: 這條河為周圍的農地帶來肥力。

examples.en: The country has seen a drop in fertility over the years.
examples.zh: 多年來，這個國家的生育率一直在下降。

examples.en: Doctors explained how age can affect fertility in both men and women.
examples.zh: 醫師說明了年齡如何影響男性與女性的生育能力。

examples.en: The shark's fin rose above the water.
examples.zh: 鯊魚的鰭露出了水面。

examples.en: A fish uses its fin to turn left or right.
examples.zh: 魚用牠的鰭來向左或向右轉彎。

examples.en: Divers wear fins on their feet to swim faster.
examples.zh: 潛水員腳上穿著蛙鞋，這樣游得更快。

examples.en: The earth has a finite supply of clean water.
examples.zh: 地球的乾淨水資源是有限的。

examples.en: We have a finite amount of time to finish the test.
examples.zh: 我們完成這份考試的時間是有限的。

examples.en: Teachers cannot give every student unlimited help with finite resources.
examples.zh: 資源有限，老師無法給每位學生無限的協助。

examples.en: Children covered their ears when the firecracker went off.
examples.zh: 鞭炮爆響時，孩子們摀住了耳朵。

examples.en: We set off a firecracker to celebrate the new year.
examples.zh: 我們放了一枚鞭炮來慶祝新年。

examples.en: Firecrackers are not allowed inside the park.
examples.zh: 公園裡不准放鞭炮。

examples.en: The company keeps important papers in a fireproof box.
examples.zh: 公司把重要文件放在防火盒裡。

examples.en: This fireproof door can stop a fire for an hour.
examples.zh: 這扇防火門能擋住火勢一個小時。

examples.en: Builders used fireproof materials for the new school.
examples.zh: 建築工人在新學校使用了防火材料。

examples.en: The town depends on its fishery for most of its income.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮的大部分收入都仰賴漁業。

examples.en: The government set new rules to protect the local fishery.
examples.zh: 政府訂定了新規定來保護當地的漁業。

examples.en: Many young men work in the fishery near the port.
examples.zh: 許多年輕男子在港口附近的漁場工作。

examples.en: A flake of snow landed on my sleeve.
examples.zh: 一片雪花落在我的袖子上。

examples.en: He added a few flakes of pepper to the soup.
examples.zh: 他在湯裡加了幾片辣椒片。

examples.en: Flakes of paint fell from the old wall.
examples.zh: 舊牆上有一片片油漆剝落。

examples.en: The paint on the door began to flake last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天，門上的油漆開始剝落。

examples.en: Dry skin can flake in the winter.
examples.zh: 乾燥的皮膚在冬天可能會脫屑。

examples.en: Use a fork to flake the cooked fish into small pieces.
examples.zh: 用叉子把煮熟的魚肉剝成小塊。

examples.en: The inspector found a flaw in the glass.
examples.zh: 檢查員在玻璃上發現了瑕疵。

examples.en: Every plan has a flaw, so we should check it carefully.
examples.zh: 每個計畫都有缺點，所以我們應該仔細檢查。

examples.en: Being late is her biggest flaw as a coworker.
examples.zh: 遲到是她身為同事最大的缺點。
